ai_triage.rationale: The Nitrate Pollution Prevention Regulations 2015 - current principal instrument for England. Title and extraordinarily extensive matched terms (the full category description plus slurry, manure, farmyard manure, pig slurry, poultry manure, liquid manure, organic manure, muck spreading, manure spreading, slurry spreading) demonstrate this is a core regulatory instrument directly regulating slurry/manure storage, spreading, application rates, closed periods, buffer zones, and nitrate pollution prevention. This is the successor to the 2008 regulations and appears to be the current principal NVZ/nitrate action programme instrument for England.
